# Theme brief — Rosebird Garden (طيور الحديقة الوردية), baby girl

Agreed with the owner on 2026-10-12. Code: `themes/rosebird-garden/v1/` (design **#8**; files only,
`onlineInvitation: false`). The girl's version of **Bluebird Garden (#7)**: the same layout and pieces
(`docs/themes/bluebird-garden/owner-designs/`), recoloured **rose** (owner chose Rose over Blush), with
girl wording. The family picture stays as is (cradle recoloured with the rest).

## Text
Fixed, Arabic in every language (not editable):
- «الحمد لله على تمام النعمة واكتمال المِنّة»
- «الحمد لله الذي جعل لنا من زينة الحياة نصيباً / ومن البنات رحمةً ونوراً» (owner's option A)
- Du'a: «جعلها الله فرحة وبركة / وغيثاً أينما حلّت»
- «@Bahjaa.iq» on the story and the card only.

Customer choices on the order form:
- **Birth order** (fixed choices): «وهبنا الله أوّل أفراحنا وأميرتنا الأولى» (default), or
  «ثاني … الثانية» / «ثالث … الثالثة» / «رابع … الرابعة».
- **Connector**: «بنت»; "Daughter of" (English), «کچی» (Sorani), «کچا» (Badini) by default for those
  languages (owner-approved 2026-10-12); or the customer's own word.
- **Father's name on the stickers and bottle**: off by default.

Everything else (fields, fonts, products, card back) is as in `docs/themes/bluebird-garden/brief.md`.
Admin: put #8 in Newborn → **Girl**, add a cover and packages, then activate.
